name: Do I need a dedicated circuit for my bathroom outlets?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a dedicated circuit for my bathroom outlets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, current electrical codes typically require a dedicated 20-amp circuit for bathroom receptacles. This is to ensure that high-wattage appliances like hair dryers, curling irons, and electric razors can be used safely without overloading the circuit. Having a dedicated circuit minimizes the risk of tripped breakers and provides a more reliable power supply for your bathroom's electrical needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a dedicated 20-amp circuit is typically required for bathroom receptacles to safely support high-wattage appliances.
